name: Battlefield Clash
description: Initiative is rolled. Driving medieval battle music with sword clashes, war horns, crossbow fire, and a charging mob on the effects board.
author: PhyberApex

source.name: Medieval: Battle by RandomMind
source.note: CC0, no attribution required. Download battle.mp3.

source.name: Boss Battle Loop 1 (155 BPM) by kanaizo
source.note: CC0. 78-second loop with a detuned piano hook. Switch to this for the big bad.

source.name: Cold Howling Wind/Breeze (Loopable) by The_Isot_is_Back
source.note: CC0. 20-second loopable wind bed under the music.

source.name: sword against sword.wav by Fenodyrie
source.note: CC0. 79 seconds of real steel on steel. Trim a 2 to 3 second hit from it.

source.name: war horn.wav by adharca
source.note: CC0. 4-second horn blast to open combat.

source.name: Crossbow Firing and Hitting Target by Ali_6868
source.note: CC0. Short fire-and-hit, great for ranged attacks.

source.name: People screaming in agony when charging into battle by florianreichelt
source.note: CC0. 18-second crowd charge for reinforcements arriving.

source.name: Explosion.mp3 by florianreichelt
